how: We read the website of every Tampa wedding photographer listed on Lazo (125 listings, 100 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: family and beach portrait studios, a photography chain with a landing page per city, a Nashville studio, and a photo-and-video collective marketed across half a dozen cities. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Have you shot a beach or outdoor ceremony here in July? Ask how they handle harsh midday sun and a sudden storm.
Can I see a full gallery from one wedding at a venue like mine, not just highlights?
What is the delivery timeline, and is a second shooter included or an add-on?

picks.name: Katie Hauburger Photography
picks.blurb: Over the past ten years Katie has photographed countless weddings and senior sessions after leaving her RN degree behind for the camera. Largo-based, with a style she describes as timeless, lighthearted imagery for couples who are ridiculously in love.

picks.name: Abundant Grace Photography
picks.blurb: Thomas has been a Tampa Bay wedding photographer since 2006 and still turns his camera toward the groom as the bride comes down the aisle. Abundant Grace in Dunedin offers collections sized from intimate celebrations to full wedding days, with a relaxed, personal approach.

picks.name: Armstrong Images Inc.
picks.blurb: Matt Armstrong's career spans more than three decades, from the darkroom to digital, and his children have joined the family business. The Clearwater studio sells photo and video as one team on one contract and says booking both together saves time and money.

picks.name: Iyrus Weddings Photo & Video
picks.blurb: A photography and videography company with a one-event-per-day policy, so the team's attention is on your wedding alone. More than ten years in the industry, all-day coverage packages that fold in an engagement session, and a willingness to travel anywhere.

picks.name: M.A.D. Images, Inc.
picks.blurb: Melissa shoots modern, romantic weddings across Tampa and Orlando plus destination celebrations, with a YOLO attitude about a day that only happens once. Her pricing page names the collections after The Office and talks money up front rather than making you ask.

picks.name: Mcneile Photography
picks.blurb: Arron started shooting in 2014 and describes photography as a passion passed down from his father and aunt. McNeile Photography in St. Petersburg does adventurous, authentic wedding photography and videography across Tampa Bay and Florida.

picks.name: A Stewart Photo and Video
picks.blurb: Husband-and-wife team Amy and Richard founded A Stewart Photo and Video in Tampa in 2011; Amy went full time in 2015 and Richard in 2021. Packages run two to fifteen hours plus multi-day, courthouse and elopement options, the company is licensed and insured, and prices are printed on the site, from $1,750 at our read.

picks.name: Sabrina Autumn Photography
picks.blurb: Sabrina handles photography and Ryan is lead videographer, and the site promises that every wedding gets the two of them. St. Petersburg-born Sabrina has photographed weddings for eight years across more than 30 states.

picks.name: Carography Studios Wedding Photographer
picks.blurb: Carolina, born and raised in Colombia, documents weddings in Tampa with a stated priority on clear communication, flexibility and empathy. She calls herself romantic and nostalgic at heart and turns candid moments into tangible heirlooms.

picks.name: Regina as The Photographer - Tampa & St. Pete Wedding Photographer - Tampa Bay Branding Product & Commercial Photographer
picks.blurb: Inclusive, nontraditional photography for the bold, the weird and the wildly in love, in Regina Rached's own words. Based in Tampa and St. Pete, she started with weddings more than 15 years ago and has shot over 500 since, alongside branding work for local businesses.

picks.name: Wild Love Photography
picks.blurb: Sasha brings structure, detail and creativity and Kevin brings the party, by their own description, and together they are booking 2026 and 2027 weddings and elopements. Wild Love Photo in Tampa promises to be more than a vendor who shows up on the day.

picks.name: Jonathan Hare Photography
picks.blurb: Jonathan's photography career began on a post-college trip through Australia and New Zealand, and he came home knowing wedding photography was his calling. St. Petersburg-based, with an artistic documentary style and work shot around the globe.
